card.situation:
USDA Forest Service combined synopsis/solicitation for floor stripping and waxing (~8,500 sq ft) at the Center for Grain and Animal Health Research, Manhattan, KS — a one-time spot task under a Total Small Business Set-Aside.
Reached the owner because NAICS 561720 is an exact match, the firm qualifies under the set-aside, and floor care is a listed core capability with relevant federal past performance.
reasons_for: Firm holds an exact NAICS 561720 match, floor care is an explicit core capability, and CIMS-GB certification directly supports the slip-resistance and product-approval requirements [4f8dba02-4d2a51d2-p18-028fa240].
Strong federal facility past performance (GSA Region 7, VA, Tinker AFB) demonstrates compliance with security access, safety, and COR coordination requirements [4f8dba02-4d2a51d2-p19-3837298e].

Firm qualifies for the Total Small Business Set-Aside and is e-Verify enrolled, with a green cleaning program that aligns with the advance product-approval requirement [4f8dba02-4d2a51d2-p18-fe4a1d15].
reasons_against: Manhattan, KS is approximately 360 miles from Oklahoma City, which is a FATAL violation of owner rule [rc-distance] prohibiting bids over 200 miles from OKC [4f8dba02-4d2a51d2-p18-de19740b].
This is a one-time spot task with no 12-month base period, which is a FATAL violation of owner rule [rc-base] requiring a minimum base period [4f8dba02-4d2a51d2-p18-171ae314].
The ~360-mile round trip from OKC to Manhattan, KS adds significant travel cost that would make the firm's pricing uncompetitive against local Kansas contractors [4f8dba02-4d2a51d2-p18-dff16849].

drafts.capability_statement:
Red Cedar Facility Services is a woman-owned small business (NAICS 561720) with a dedicated floor care capability and a proven record of performance on federal facility contracts. Our team of 38 W-2 employees delivers professional janitorial and custodial services — including floor stripping, waxing, and slip-resistance management — using a documented green cleaning program with products submitted for facility management approval prior to use.

We hold CIMS-GB certification and operate a quality control program supported by a CMMS for scheduling and inspection logging, ensuring work is completed on time and with minimal disruption to building occupants. Our OSHA 30-certified supervisors oversee all field operations and enforce site safety compliance on every engagement.

Red Cedar has performed custodial and housekeeping services in occupied federal buildings, including work for GSA Region 7 and the Department of Veterans Affairs, where we have coordinated site access with CORs, complied with facility security procedures, and maintained infection-control and safety standards throughout performance. We are enrolled in e-Verify and maintain full compliance with applicable federal labor requirements.

For this requirement at the Center for Grain and Animal Health Research, Red Cedar would provide all labor, materials, and equipment necessary to strip and wax approximately 8,500 square feet of flooring, with travel costs included in our proposal pricing. We are prepared to name qualified Primary and Alternate personnel and to document all equipment to be used at time of quote submission.

Red Cedar is registered in SAM.gov and qualifies as a total small business under this set-aside.
